description: This Java source file defines the IntellijProject class, which is responsible for building IntelliJ IDEA project files from a given Android repository. It manages modules, dependencies, and configuration files such as modules.xml, vcs.xml, and .idea/.name, handling framework modules and setting up project directories.

classes.name: IntellijProject
classes.description: Main class for building IntelliJ IDEA project files from Android source repository.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes cache, processes framework and modules, and creates project files.

methods.name: createProjectFiles
methods.description: Creates the .idea directory and generates modules.xml, vcs.xml, and .name files.

methods.name: buildFrameWorkModule
methods.description: Handles special building of the framework module.

methods.name: createModulesFile
methods.description: Generates the modules.xml file listing all modules.

methods.name: createVcsFile
methods.description: Generates the vcs.xml file mapping directories with version control systems.

methods.name: createNameFile
methods.description: Creates the .name file with the project name.

methods.name: copyTemplates
methods.description: Copies project templates into the .idea directory.
